title: IndiaMART Product & Supplier Scraper Input
description: Extract non-personal product and supplier listing facts from public IndiaMART category pages for sourcing and market research.

keywords.title: Category Keywords
keywords.description: IndiaMART category keywords. The actor converts each keyword to a category URL, for example cotton fabric -> /impcat/cotton-fabric.html.

location.title: Single Location (legacy)
location.description: Optional single city retained for existing integrations. The Locations list below takes priority when supplied.

locations.title: Locations for Deeper Coverage
locations.description: Optional cities to fan out each keyword across, for example Surat, Jaipur, and Mumbai. This produces broader coverage while deduplicating suppliers.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum clean supplier records to save across all keywords.

includeOrganic.title: Include Organic Cards
includeOrganic.description: Extract visible organic supplier/product cards from the category page.

includeSponsored.title: Include Sponsored Data
includeSponsored.description: Extract sponsored/all-India records from embedded page data when available.

includeDetails.title: Enrich Public Product Details
includeDetails.description: Open each public product/company page for additional specifications, ratings, public business address, and clearly labelled official company website when available. Personal phone numbers and emails are never collected.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential India proxy is recommended for stable access to IndiaMART category pages.
